frozenBy: P254f — written and fingerprinted BEFORE the evaluation below was run; the candidate, split and bars may not be changed after seeing any 2025 interval result
motivation: The 2026 preseason margin interval printed as 80% contained the result 65.9% of the time (41 forecasts, z -2.26), and P180 already recorded that margins miss on blowouts. The regular-season margin interval (Normal, sigma fitted on 2023-24 residuals) has NEVER been measured for interval coverage: model-v1-evaluation's 'coverage' is the share of games predicted, not interval coverage.

candidate.definition: identical mean (a*d, same slope, same Elo replay) — only dispersion changes: the 80% interval is [mean + q10, mean + q90] where q10/q90 are the empirical 10th/90th percentiles of the TRAIN residuals (margin - a*d), 2023-2024 regular season + postseason
candidate.why: normality cannot put the observed blowout mass in the tails; empirical quantiles let the residuals speak
candidate.onlyOneCandidate: exactly one challenger is registered, so the result is not a best-of-many selection

split.preseason: excluded from fit and test, as in model-v1

bars.maeRule: margin MAE not worse than the incumbent's by more than 0.5 points (identical mean => satisfied by construction; reported anyway)

decisionRule: This 2025 retrospective is INFORMATIONAL. Per the frozen contract, a regular-season head is promoted only through the 2026 walk-forward (fit through week N-1, forecast week N, >= 64 games over >= 4 weeks). The candidate therefore runs in SHADOW on every 2026 regular-season forecast and is promoted automatically when that sample exists and it is inside the band while the incumbent is not — or rejected, and recorded as rejected.
